$schema.description: Path or URL of teletronix.schema.json, for checking and autocomplete in editors

name.description: The program's name, shown as the page title

start.description: The first screen (default: the first one)

reveal.description: How text appears on every screen, unless a screen or element says otherwise (default: "teletype")

oneOf.description: Types the text one character at a time

duration.description: Milliseconds for the text to resolve (default: config.defaults.glitch)

Shows the text all at once

transition.description: How screens leave, unless the next screen says otherwise (default: "none")

oneOf.description: The old screen disappears at once

duration.description: Milliseconds for the old screen to erase (default: config.defaults.glitch)

oneOf.description: The old screen erases itself over the new one as it appears
The old screen fades out behind the new one, like phosphor afterglow
A brief burst of full-screen noise, like changing channels, before the new screen

glitch.description: Default glitch options, for reveals and transitions

anyOf.description: CRT scanlines, with an optional rolling band. On by default.

opacity.description: Strength of the noise, from 0 to 1 (default: 0.15)
